summary: Three of Russia’s largest grain terminals in the Black Sea port of Novorossiysk have halted operations after being damaged in a massive overnight drone attack by Ukraine.

title: Richest to Profit in Trump’s Capital Gain Tax Ideas for Midterms
title_cn: 最富有的人将从特朗普的中期选举资本利得税想法中获利
summary: The White House is considering throwing its weight behind a push to increase a capital gains tax exemption for primary home sales and cut levies on investments ahead of the midterm election — changes that would disproportionately flow to some of the wealthiest US households.

title: ICE Wants Agents to Have Electric-Shock Gloves for Detainees
title_cn: ICE 希望特工为被拘留者配备电击手套
summary: Federal immigration agents are looking to buy gloves that can inflict electric shocks on detainees as President Donald Trump intensifies his mass arrest and deportation drive.

title: DOJ Lawyer Evades Ethics Sanction Over Journalist’s Home Search
